items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: I mostly remember Celestan or like that during that time, you know.

ctx.x: You never saw him on the street in the parades?

No, no, no, no, no, no. I think he played with the tuxedo band. No, no, I don't remember him then, no, no. I mostly remember Celestan or like that during that time, you know. Did you ever? Yeah, I did a parades and all like that at that time.
Did you ever play much in the brass bands on the street?
